name: add
description: Adds two integers and returns the sum.

name: echo
description: Returns the given text back unchanged.

name: roll_dice
description: Rolls a die with the given number of sides, returning a random result from 1 to sides.

sides.description: Number of sides on the die.

name: list_dir
description: Lists files in a directory (demo of the process kind).

name: identify_image
description: Runs ImageMagick's `identify` on a previously uploaded file and returns its format/size/etc. Demonstrates the file_id -> {file_path} flow: upload the image via PUT /files on this server's file service (port given as the second startup argument, default 8765), then call this tool with the returned file_id. File bytes never travel through MCP tool-call arguments — see MANUAL.md.

file_id.description: file_id returned by a prior upload to this server's file service.

name: convert_image
description: Runs ImageMagick's `convert` on a previously uploaded file (see identify_image's description for the upload flow) with the given arguments (e.g. "-resize 50%"), and returns a new file_id for the result — download it via GET /files/{file_id} on this server's file service. File bytes never travel through MCP tool-call arguments or results.

file_id.description: file_id returned by a prior upload to this server's file service.

output_ext.description: File extension for the converted output, without the dot (e.g. "png", "jpg").

name: view_image
description: Opens the given image file in the infimg viewer on this machine's desktop (fit-to-window, arbitrary rotation, zoom/pan) and returns immediately without waiting for the window to close. Optionally target one of infimg's 10 remembered window-position slots (0-9), e.g. to keep a fixed monitoring/alert layout.

file.description: Path to the image file to open.

slot.description: Window-position slot (0-9) to open into. Omit for the default slot 0.

name: view_image_data
description: Opens an uploaded image (base64-encoded) in the infimg viewer on this machine's desktop and returns immediately without waiting for the window to close. Useful for showing a snapshot or alert image that only exists in-memory on the caller's side, e.g. a monitoring/bridge station. Optionally target one of infimg's 10 remembered window-position slots (0-9).

image_ext.description: File extension for the image, without the dot (e.g. "png", "jpg"). Defaults to "png".

slot.description: Window-position slot (0-9) to open into. Omit for the default slot 0.

name: look_at_image
description: Sends a previously uploaded image to the local vision-capable gemma-4-e4b model running in LM Studio, along with a question, and returns its answer. Reasoning/thinking is disabled so the model answers directly instead of emitting a chain-of-thought preamble. Upload the image via PUT /files on this server's file service (port given as the second startup argument, default 8765), then call this tool with the returned file_id — file bytes never travel through MCP tool-call arguments, avoiding a real bug where a large inline base64 argument stalls the calling model's own response stream; see MANUAL.md and docs/archive/2026-08-13-look-at-image-hang.md.

file_id.description: file_id returned by a prior upload to this server's file service.

image_ext.description: File extension for the image, without the dot (e.g. "png", "jpg"). Defaults to "jpg".

question.description: What to ask the model about the image.

name: ask_gemma
description: Sends a prompt to the local gemma-4-e4b model running in llama.cpp's llama-server (reasoning/CoT disabled) and returns its raw JSON response.
